pages.text: PROBLEM 16-22 How might you synthesize the following substances from benzene? (a) m-Chloronitrobenzene (b) m-Chloroethylbenzene (c) 4-Chloro-1-nitro-2-propylbenzene (d) 3-Bromo-2-methylbenzenesulfonic acid
